caption: The drawing features three views of a single iron object. At the top of the drawing is a plan (top-down) view, displaying an iron plate with a pointed oval shape, rounded along one end, with a symmetrical geometric pattern of cutouts and a series of circular holes around the perimeter. In the center is a side elevation view, showing the plate is supported by four short legs and has a generally flat surface with slight upward curves at two ends, with an accompanying scale bar below indicating measurement in inches. At the bottom of the drawing is a perspective view, showing the three-dimensional form of the object, emphasizing the shaped legs and the detailed pattern on its upper surface. The iron object is rendered in gray tones, and the drawing is set against an off-white background. The name "J. BELLAMY" is written at the lower left corner of the page.
title: Flat Iron Holder
